log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed 8, all quick afternoon. Avoid morning: >2 morning deaths also exclude students; afternoon-only >2 excludes day workers, leaving 55%=55,000 initially. Maintain afternoon quick entries; up to 2 timed entries may be placed elsewhere. Strategy: kill national and forum/foreign-reported criminals; avoid standalone wire, cable, or North until feedback establishes safety. Even if traces establish both forum and foreign readership, afternoon-compatible pool is 3,437.5, safely above 1,000; adding sector or age restrictions could lose. Forum/foreign-containing cases add no further restrictions once those readerships established. L cannot trace two unknown source kinds; multi-source cases may block tracing. Target >=8 kills/day for 40 in five days and 4x multiplier. Selected all available forum/foreign cases; excluded wire-only d1-1,d1-8 and cable-only d1-11. Await day-3 press feedback.

Day 1 killed 8; day 2 selected 6, all quick afternoon (14 total). Even if L establishes both forum and foreign readership, routine-compatible pool remains 3,437.5, above capture threshold; adding sector, age or region constraints could cause capture. Cases containing forum/foreign remain safe even with additional reporting locations, since following forum and foreign satisfies all those trace constraints. Two source kinds are inaccessible to L, unknown which. Await day-3 conference. Need 40 deaths within five days for 4x, or 30 for 2x; prioritize survival over unsafe kills.
